result.explanation: The customer paid, the payment provider told us, but the client-side confirm call never happened — consistent with the confirm button being unreachable after payment. [orders:ord_0902] [server_logs:2026-10-15T20:00:31Z@/api/payments/webhook]
result.customer_reply: We can see your payment of 9900 KRW was successful, but the order did not confirm because the confirmation step didn’t reach our system. Once approved, we will manually confirm the order and apply your reward. No further action is needed from you.
result.fix_action: Confirm the order server-side from the PAID webhook and grant credits (requires approval). Code fix: never rely on a client click after a PAID webhook.

claims.sentence: The payment provider recorded a PAID charge of 9900 KRW for order ord_0902 [payments:pay_0902] and our server logged the PSP webhook PAID [server_logs:2026-10-15T20:00:31Z@/api/payments/webhook], but the order record remains pending with no /confirm request [orders:ord_0902].
This indicates the client‑side confirmation step did not reach our backend, leaving the order unconfirmed despite successful payment.
